_readme: Copy to boards.json. Each entry is ONE company's public ATS board. 'token' is the slug in the board URL (e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, jobs.lever.co/<token>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<token>). Firmographics are optional and must come from a source you trust; without 'employees' the company stays 'unclassified' and is excluded from the 35/30/35 quotas rather than guessed.
